response.what_it_is: PlayStation 4 Slim console with two DualShock controllers and cables
hidden_risks: Console may be network banned or restricted
Controllers may suffer from stick drift or worn battery life
Installed digital games are typically tied to the seller's PSN account and may not be accessible
Internal hard drive health and disc drive functionality are unverified
response.best_proof: Photo of the console powered on showing the dashboard, system software version, and account status
response.failure_mode: Assuming digital games transfer permanently to the buyer and overvaluing the bundle without testing internal hardware or network status.
